استبصرا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْصَرَا (istabṣarā) /is.tab.sˤa.raː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
# اِسْتَبْصِرَا (istabṣirā) /is.tab.sˤi.raː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَبْصَرَ (istabṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
